gaps.note: This v2 roughly quintuples the handle count (~230 → ~1,100). All NEW handles are best-effort from memory and MUST pass a live existence/activity check before seeding — accounts go dormant, rename, or migrate to Bluesky (F1 press, some critics, several academics). Budget a scripted verification pass (batch profile lookups) as part of the seed job.

gaps.item: India coverage now embedded per root
gaps.note: Instead of one India sub-niche per root, India voices appear in Geopolitics (India & Global South), Business (India markets), Politics (India politics), Sport (cricket + India multi-sport), Arts (India film). UK/EU politics now covered; other regional lenses (Africa, LatAm) live only in Geopolitics.

Sports analytics, esports, science-explainers, creator economy, solar & storage, biodiversity, art market, theater are 6–8 handles — X is genuinely thin there (YouTube/newsletters are the primary medium). Kept small rather than padded with link-spam accounts; room to grow post-launch from engagement data.

gaps.item: YouTube long-form rule vs official channels
gaps.note: League/label/lab official channels (NBA, NFL, UFC, Formula 1, OpenAI, YRF) mix long-form with highlight clips and promos. Keep them (reliable volume + rights-safe) but have ingestion filter by duration ≥10min; House of Highlights is the weakest fit and is first to cut.

1:1 achieved everywhere; Tech carries a 16th bonus cluster (Big-tech leaders) alongside Tech media, both feeding the Tech-business sub-niche. Cross-root duplicates are rare but deliberate (e.g. @TheEconomist in world desks + markets desks); dedupe on (cluster_id, handle), not globally.
Institutional handles (leagues, wires, agencies, museums) post original content but also heavy links; keep them but weight person-accounts higher in digest assembly, as in v1.

Progressive and conservative media are now separate sub-niches with parallel clusters (10 handles each); cable desks (MSNBC/Fox) are labelled left/right in the YT table so allocation can balance rather than blend.

Engagement-bait aggregators (@sentdefender-style), retweet-heavy fan accounts, and deceased/defunct accounts were filtered during curation; the verification pass should re-apply the same bar to anything it flags.
